_meta.title: Session 37 — 17-link multi-source ingest: 3 CAD benchmarks (CADBench/BenchCAD/Text2CAD-Bench) + FACTS Leaderboard + SCADBench ELO + CompassRank multimodal + T-Bench 2.1 additions
_meta.context: 17 user-provided links analyzed via 9 parallel research agents + direct WebFetch verification of 4 key sources (LocateAnything-pattern). De-dup: SCADBench.com (community ELO arena) and Modelrift blog (1-task Pantheon) are DISTINCT, only SCADBench ingested. world-models.io (no scores, editorial) and CVPR-2026 GigaBrain (team competition submissions, not foundation models) → Resources only. OpenVLM HF Space data stale (Sep 2025), CompassRank Multimodal (REALTIME 20260526) used instead. Kilo.ai is a Terminal-Bench 2.0 re-run with DIFFERENT harness numbers from official tbench.ai (clobber risk) → Resources only. Vellum already in seed_sources; GPT-5.5 SWE-Bench 58.6 flagged anomalous by agent → SKIP, Resources only. SWE-Bench official leaderboard stale (2025-12 latest, clobber risk) → SKIP. T-Bench v1.0 has no 2026 frontier → SKIP. T-Bench 2.1/2.0 multi-agent rows reported but BEST agent+model combos clobber existing system-card scores → only ADD net-new model entries to avoid loader-REPLACE.
_meta.rule: STRICT-ATTRIBUTION. Every triple verified by direct WebFetch of the source table or JSON (CADBench T2, BenchCAD T2, Text2CAD-Bench T1-T2, SCADBench api/leaderboard JSON, CompassRank REALTIME JSON, FACTS T1, tbench.ai 2.1). Comparison-model scores ingested ONLY on NEWLY-CREATED benchmarks (no clobber risk). T-Bench 2.1 net-new model entries only (gemini-3-pro Terminus 2 74.4, glm-5.1 Claude Code 58.7) — existing rows untouched. EXCLUDED: SCADBench minimax-m2.5/nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b/gpt-4o-2024-11-20-snapshot (models not in DB, low priority), CongRong-v2.0 (publisher unclear, no vendor namespace), Modelrift tool+model combos (not pure model scores), Kilo.ai TB2 re-runs (harness mismatch with official).

benchmarks.name: CADBench (IoU)
benchmarks.description: MIT CADBench — multimodal CAD program generation (mesh/single-view/multi-view/render -> CAD code). 18,000 evaluation samples across 6 families. Aggregate IoU on clean inputs, higher=better. arxiv 2605.10873.

benchmarks.name: BenchCAD-QA (Vision Total)
benchmarks.description: UVA/Rice BenchCAD-QA — Vision-side total score on 2,400 image/code QA items (image -> CadQuery reasoning). 0-1, higher=better. arxiv 2605.10865.

benchmarks.name: Text2CAD-Bench (L4 Overall)
benchmarks.description: Text-to-parametric CAD generation, Level 4 (most complex) Overall score (VLM-judged 0-10). 100 L4 prompts. Higher=better. arxiv 2605.18430.

benchmarks.name: SCADBench (OpenSCAD Arena ELO)
benchmarks.description: Crowdsourced OpenSCAD code-generation arena — pairwise blind votes on STL renders from natural-language prompts. ELO rating starting at 1200 (Chatbot-Arena style). 5,325 total votes / 19 models as of 2026-05-30. Higher=better.

benchmarks.name: FACTS Score (aggregate)
benchmarks.description: Google+Anthropic FACTS Leaderboard aggregate — mean of 4 factuality sub-benches (Grounding v2 + Multimodal + Parametric + Search). Higher=better. arxiv 2512.10791 (Dec 2025).

benchmarks.name: FACTS Grounding v2
benchmarks.description: Long-form document grounding factuality (judge-ensemble score). Higher=better. FACTS sub-bench.

benchmarks.name: FACTS Search
benchmarks.description: Info-seeking factuality with search API access. Accuracy %. Higher=better. FACTS sub-bench.

benchmarks.name: CompassRank Multimodal (8-bench Avg)
benchmarks.description: Shanghai AI Lab CompassRank Multimodal leaderboard — mean of 8 underlying benchmarks (MMBench V1.1, MMStar, MMMU, MathVista, HallusionBench, AI2D, OCRBench, MMVet). REALTIME data 2026-05-26. Higher=better.
